meta_title: Big Mal's Decorating | Painter & Decorator Leeds
meta_description: Big Mal's Decorating in Leeds. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, reliable service. Call 07908 722331.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Local Decorator — 15+ Years in Leeds
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full room transformations, Big Mal's delivers flawless paintwork and wallpapering across Leeds and surrounding areas.
services_subhead: Whether you need a fresh coat, wallpaper hung, or a complete room makeover, we handle every detail with precision.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork painted to a professional finish. We prep properly, use quality paints, and protect your furniture and floors.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior paintwork for fascias, doors, windows, and rendered walls. We work in all weather conditions and ensure lasting protection.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Pattern matching, feature walls, and full room wallpapering. We remove old paper carefully and hang new designs with precision.

services.title: Furniture & Upcycling
services.desc: Refresh old furniture, kitchen units, and built-ins with professional spray finishing or hand-painted detail work.

services.title: Damp & Problem Walls
services.desc: Preparation and sealing of damp-affected surfaces before decoration ensures your new finish lasts. We identify the issue first.

services.title: Commercial Spaces
services.desc: Office redecorating, retail refreshes, and commercial interiors. We work around your schedule with minimal disruption.

about_pullquote: I take pride in leaving every home looking better than we found it.
about_para_1: Big Mal's Decorating was founded on a simple idea: deliver honest, skilled paintwork without the nonsense. With over 15 years' experience across Leeds and the surrounding areas, we've built a reputation for turning tired rooms into spaces our customers love. From Victorian terraces to modern semis, we understand what works in Yorkshire homes.
about_para_2: We're a small, dedicated team that shows up on time, respects your home, and leaves you with a finish you'll be proud of. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth recommendations — that's how we know we're doing it right. No cowboys, no shortcuts, just proper decorating.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Big Mal's

reviews.text: Mal painted our entire downstairs and hung the new wallpaper in the living room. The prep work was thorough, no mess left behind, and he finished bang on schedule. Would definitely have him back.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Brilliant with my daughter's bedroom. She wanted a feature wall with a tricky pattern and Mal got it spot on. Very professional bloke, reasonable prices, and he talks you through everything.
reviews.author: Karen S.

reviews.text: Had Big Mal in to do the hallway and stairs. The finish is immaculate, he's tidy, and he didn't faff about with unnecessary extras. Honest decorator. Can't recommend him enough.
reviews.author: Michael P.
